Finance notifications correctly trigger for: transaction creation, quota generation, settings changes
Notification API endpoints properly implement pagination, filtering, mark-all-read, delete, and clear-all
Frontend NotificacoesPage correctly displays notification types with appropriate icons and colors
FinanceiroPage refactoring is clean with separate CashFlowTab, DRETab, SettingsTab components
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during testing (TEST_ prefixed projects, tasks, expenses, transactions)
